subject: MANDATORY WITH CHOICE: Optional Dividend (Cash vs Scrip Shares) for TotalEnergies SE (ISIN: FR0000120271)
body:
BNP PARIBAS SECURITIES SERVICES
EVENT NOTIFICATION: OPTIONAL DIVIDEND / SCRIP ELECTION (DVOP)

Issuer: TOTALENERGIES SE (ISIN: FR0000120271)
Event: Q3 2026 Interim Optional Dividend

Election Options:
Option 1: 100% Cash Dividend at EUR 0.79 per share
Option 2: Scrip Dividend - Receive new ordinary shares at discounted subscription price EUR 58.20 per share

DEFAULT OPTION: Option 1 (100% Cash)

Election Deadlines:
- Custodian Election Deadline: 14-OCT-2026 16:00 CET
- Settlement / Payment Date: 26-OCT-2026

Action Required: Solicit Portfolio Manager investment election between cash yield and equity compounding before the deadline.
